name: spine-motion-kit
description: Spine 4.3 流暢動作產生器：預設動作、畫面空間重定向、物理烘焙、IK 保護、流暢度檢查、預覽

scripts.demo: node bin/spine-motion.js generate examples/rigs/fighter.json examples/recipes/fighter.recipe.json -o examples/out/fighter.motion.json --check --preview && node bin/spine-motion.js generate examples/rigs/symbol.json examples/recipes/symbol.recipe.json -o examples/out/symbol.motion.json --check --preview
